title: wolfssl_ec_key_import: SPKI DER import does not validate curve matches ctx
description: In wolfssl_ec_key_import, when key_type is PUBLIC and raw[0]==0x30 (SPKI DER), the code calls wc_EccPublicKeyDecode without verifying the decoded curve matches ctx->curve_id. A P-384 SPKI DER can be imported into an ecdh-p256 or ecdsa-p256 context. Subsequent operations will use P-256 parameters (scalar_len=32, pubkey_len=65) against a P-384 key, producing incorrect results or wolfCrypt errors at operation time with confusing diagnostics. Fix: after wc_EccPublicKeyDecode, call wc_ecc_get_curve_id() on the decoded key and verify it equals ctx->curve_id.
